_readme: Curated seed of REAL, publicly-filed planned projects — Savannah River corridor (Savannah + Augusta scenes) plus statewide GA/SC coverage (Charleston, Columbia, lowcountry, Pee Dee, upstate SC; Athens, Atlanta, Macon, Columbus, central & south GA). Every record cites a public source (SCRTP/SERTP plan docs, SC PSC dockets, GA ITS ten-year plan, IRPs). Coordinates verified against OSM power=* features and/or HIFLD junction analysis; see data/raw/filings/PROJECTS_EXTRACT.md for the underlying extraction and raw PDFs. location_confidence: verified = named facility coordinate confirmed; endpoint_only = straight line between verified endpoint substations; approximate = town/site centroid or unnamed OSM yard nearest the filed site, exact pad site unpublished. NO fabricated entries.
